maddeler.e:
نتجلبب (form IIq)
# نَتَجَلْبَبُ (natajalbabu) /na.ta.d͡ʒal.ba.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَجَلْبَبَ (tajalbaba)
# نَتَجَلْبَبَ (natajalbaba) /na.ta.d͡ʒal.ba.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَجَلْبَبَ (tajalbaba)
# نَتَجَلْبَبْ (natajalbab) /na.ta.d͡ʒal.bab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَجَلْبَبَ (tajalbaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
